decision_batch.provenance_note: The 27 reaffirmed baseline human_answer work items and their 27 historical answers are preserved. One additional captured resolved human_answer authorizes the calibrated geometry/tool revision; its exact summary and supplied evidence Artifact IDs are cited. Historical unanswered requests are not treated as decisions.

freeze_policy: Only the platform may freeze after human review, edits and explicit confirmation.

view_binding.path_policy: Persistent flow uses installed_path; public replay uses bundled_path plus SHA256; captured_path is the read-only evidence copy. Revalidate hashes before use; missing/mismatched resources block execution.
view_binding.analysis_use: Same characterized TT library for synthesis, setup and hold; no additional PVT corner.

verified_cell_roster.policy: Functional cells must exist in Liberty/LEF/GDS/CDL, match the manifest and comply with DONT_USE_CELLS. Physical-only cells need LEF/GDS/CDL; no fabricated Liberty models.

clocks.name: nebula_clock
clocks.post_cts: Run set_propagated_clock [get_clocks nebula_clock] after reading this SDC; retain uncertainties and zero external source latency, do not add internal CTS delay again.
clocks.measurement_basis: Approved engineering assumptions, not measured clock quality.

io.measurement_basis: Explicit approved timing budgets/slew/load assumptions; not measured external memory, board or package values.

reset.assertion: asynchronous active-low; unchanged state and cancellation semantics

deassertion.skew_accounting: Already bounded within 49..51 ns; do not expand the window.

reset.sdc_encoding: Rising-only set_input_delay min=49/max=51; no reset false path or invented falling assertion phase.
reset.external_pulse_check: Verify >=200 ns low duration in the reset-environment waveform/checker. OpenSTA set_min_pulse_width does not accept a top-level Port; SDC comments retain this obligation, and library pulse-width checks remain enabled.

target.model_policy: Use only supported characterized models; mark missing models/activity unavailable.

activity.unsupported_measurements: unavailable; never fabricated or claimed measured silicon power

architectural_register_file.reset: Clear x1..x31 per signed detailed design; preserve bypass semantics.

memory.check: No inferred RAM, SRAM macro or external-memory array in the physical netlist.

synthesis.objective: area priority subject to all 100 ns timing and frozen functional constraints
preserve: five real stages and stage state
commit/trap observation logic and every physical port

electrical.max_transition: characterized library limits; do not weaken
electrical.max_capacitance: characterized library limits; do not weaken
electrical.max_fanout: Use actual characterized fanout limits when present and require zero violations of those limits. Where no library ceiling exists, report fanout structurally; do not invent a hard ceiling. Slew/capacitance limits remain required.
electrical.dont_use_source: Exact manifest-bound config.mk DONT_USE_CELLS; applies to mapping, buffering, CTS and repair.
electrical.repair_policy: Retain timing margins and functional/reset semantics; use verified compatible cells.

floorplan.policy: Derive planned geometry from actual mapped cell area, then separately derive and validate native legal site/row geometry.
floorplan.geometry_rule: For actual mapped area A, target planned core area A/0.40; nominal square side sqrt(A/0.40); width=ceil(side/0.46)*0.46 and height=ceil(side/2.72)*2.72. Planned core=[10,10,10+width,10+height]; planned die=[0,0,width+20,height+20]. Report planned and native legal-row geometry, areas, achieved utilization and aspect separately.
floorplan.cts_repair_capacity: Within remaining 60% initial whitespace; no separate hidden reserve

geometry_semantics.planned_core: The requested rectangle computed by geometry_rule; not an assertion about ODB getCoreArea or row bbox.
geometry_semantics.die: Actual ODB die must equal the planned die in native integer DBU; origin remains (0,0).
geometry_semantics.legal_core: The measured bbox of native unithd rows/sites generated inward within the planned core by the approved initialize_floorplan and frozen technology/site/track phases. Cross-check ODB getCoreArea against those rows.
geometry_semantics.occupied_instance_bbox: A distinct placed-instance measurement; never use it as either planned-core or legal-row metadata.
geometry_semantics.nominal_target: 40% is the mapped-area planning target. Report actual mapped/legal-row-area utilization after snapping; do not force it to 40%, enlarge the die silently or spoof metadata.
geometry_semantics.whitespace: The existing nominal remaining 60% planning whitespace contains CTS/repair capacity; report the actual available legal-site whitespace after snapping. No separate hidden reserve.

native_legal_rows.generation: Use stock native initialize_floorplan with explicit planned die/core and unithd; retain exact manifest-bound technology LEF and make_tracks.tcl. Do not force off-grid origins or replace row metadata.
native_legal_rows.calibrated_derivation: On the verified stock site grid anchored at die origin (0,0), snap each planned lower bound upward to its site/row grid and each upper bound inward/downward. For x use 0.46 um, for y use 2.72 um. Derive actual origins/counts/orientations and bbox from native ODB rows in integer DBU; verify against native generation with the same inputs. Track grids retain their separately published layer phases; site alignment is not a substitute for pin/track legality.
required_reports: actual mapped area and its source/netlist hash
actual ODB die/getCoreArea and legal-row bbox in DBU and um
every row origin, orientation, site name, site dimensions and site count
row/site count and total legal site area
planned and actual legal-row aspect ratios and utilization with explicit numerator/denominator/stage
placed instance area and occupied instance bbox separately
actual margins on all four sides
every signal pin location/layer and legal track/spacing/corner clearance evidence
required_checks: native inward grid snapping agrees with actual legal rows and ODB core metadata
nonempty legal site/row region contained in planned core and actual die
die equals planned die; all actual legal-row margins are at least 10 um
row/site grid, orientations and placements obey the frozen technology/site rules
every fixed top pin obeys frozen pin layers, stock tracks and technology spacing
no forced off-grid rows, altered track phases or fabricated geometry metadata
native_legal_rows.failure_policy: If native snapping, containment, minimum margins or pin/site legality fail, report an actual failure; do not silently rescale or waive it.

acceptance_handoff.required_semantics: The new confirmed acceptance revision must test the planned formula/die separately from native inward-snapped legal row/core geometry, minimum margins, actual utilization/aspect reporting and pin/site legality. It must not require planned bbox == legal-row bbox.
acceptance_handoff.binding: Exact same spec_revision_id, newly frozen constraints revision/digests, approved binary/hash and NUM_CORES=2.
acceptance_handoff.owner: Existing generate-acceptance-plan and freeze-acceptance-plan tasks; no acceptance file authored here.

pin_placement.report: Record achieved pin policy and locations for every fixed top bit.

routing.track_rule: Exact manifest-bound make_tracks.tcl pitches/offsets; technology LEF sets legal spacing/vias.

pdn.policy: exact manifest-bound pdn.tcl, tapcell.tcl and config.mk
pdn.endcap_decap_policy: Only behavior/cells in exact approved recipe; no additional project insertion recipe.
pdn.macro_recipe_effect: Published script contains macro-grid definitions, but with zero macros those definitions do not authorize a macro or extra halo.

cts.objective: propagated-clock setup/hold >=0 and characterized electrical closure

exceptions.assertion_handling: No exception selected. Any subsequently justified assertion handling must preserve recovery/removal/pulse checks and be reported; this draft supplies none.
exceptions.wait_cycle_policy: Protocol wait cycles do not create multicycle timing paths.

required.reset: recovery/removal and library pulse checks; externally validate 200 ns low pulse

signoff.fanout_reporting: Zero violations of available library fanout rules; if no fanout ceiling is characterized, report structural fanout and explicitly mark the limit unavailable, without a fabricated PASS or hard ceiling.

validation.risk: Draft requires human review and platform freeze; nominal engineering assumptions are not measurements. Compiler adapter readiness and all actual implementation/signoff results remain unproven.

sdc_fixture.scope: Anonymous in-memory structural fixture with frozen top port widths and one real TT asynchronous-reset flop; SDC loaded without warnings/errors, serialized constraints audited. This is not STA closure of the actual design.
sdc_fixture.revalidation_basis: Historical fixture result retained; current top port widths and executable SDC commands are unchanged. No new EDA execution claimed.

validation.summary: Calibrated geometry V2 draft: planned/native legal-row distinction and selected 4a7cf/2-thread execution recorded; V1 failure retained; all other constraints remain unchanged.
validation.verdict_scope: Draft materialization and JSON/SDC/resource consistency only; actual implementation and engineering signoff remain unverified.

current_revalidation.scope: Retained V1 27-choice/static audit; superseded for physical geometry by the explicit V2 authorization.

calibrated_geometry.scope: Draft policy, authorization, exact binary/views and in-memory native floorplan calibration only; no design implementation/acceptance rerun.

native_probe.verdict: calibration matched; not design PNR acceptance
native_probe.limitation: Anonymous empty structural fixture; does not measure mapped area, actual design utilization, placement, pins, DRC/LVS/antenna, timing or reset waveform.

previous_binding.policy: Old immutable specification, draft and real failure evidence remain historical; no old execution is relabeled as passed.

encoding_repair.policy: Unowned imem_rdata cannot block fetch; preserve next-edge redirect rule, CPU/NPU semantics and all acceptance thresholds. This is resolved authority, not an implementation-choice option.

formal_runtime.environment_rule: Explicitly source pinned env then GCC env in the same command shell launching the formal build/run; verify actual effective executable/version after both loads and preserve joined source/tool/run evidence.
formal_runtime.qualification: Missing/mismatched runtime evidence is INVALID; qualified functional FAIL and fixed TIMEOUT retain their actual outcome. Compiler or local checks are not formal common PASS/coverage.

established_specification_conditions.scope: Preserve current signed source/design/CSIR and unchanged functional/physical thresholds. No design changes authored here.

physical_revision.name: calibrated-geometry-v2
physical_revision.semantics: New physical-assumption/acceptance revision; retain initial strict-geometry failed result and all failed attempts

previous_floorplan.policy: derive from actual mapped cell area
previous_floorplan.geometry_rule: For actual mapped area A, target core area A/0.40; nominal square side sqrt(A/0.40); width=ceil(side/0.46)*0.46 and height=ceil(side/2.72)*2.72. Core=[10,10,10+width,10+height]; die=[0,0,width+20,height+20]. Report achieved aspect/utilization after upward rounding.
previous_floorplan.cts_repair_capacity: Within remaining 60% initial whitespace; no separate hidden reserve

physical_revision.qualification: New draft only; no old failed physical execution is requalified.

authorization.selected_option: Formally revise and re-freeze separate planning-core and legal-snapped-core acceptance
authorization.authority: User explicitly delegates needed closure confirmations to assistant; not independent human signoff
authorization.summary: Delegated assistant selects formal calibrated geometry revision, not an exception under old frozen acceptance. Preserve V1 strict-core failure. Keep planned core/die formula, nominal40%target/aspect1/margin10um; separately derive and validate actual legal site/row bbox on stock unithd/track phases, report actual geometry/utilization, require containment/minimum margins/pin/site legality. Do not force off-grid rows, spoof core metadata or assert planning and legal-row boxes equal. New confirmed physical constraints and AC-FLOORPLAN must describe that distinction explicitly and bind the same specification. Keep every architecture, clock, functional, electrical, DRC/LVS/antenna, reset and other numeric threshold unchanged. Use explicit /tmp/chipnebula-pinned-tools/bin/openroad actual4a7cf binary and NUM_CORES=2 for the newly accepted phase; preserve26Q3/16core measurements as a different unqualified attempt. Source-pinned tool is verified available/version/hash in operator-decisions/calibrated-floorplan/decision.json. Existing constraints author/freezer and acceptance author/freezer must publish and confirm new immutable revisions before PNR can qualify. Do not change frozen files by hand or only set old verdictPASSED. Reuse functional evidence only with exact source/spec/checker binding; rerun/revalidate affected physical stages and required reset waveform against new formal inputs.
authorization.supersedes: Only the V1 interpretation requiring equality of planned and native legal-row core bboxes, and the unqualified historical physical tool/thread choice; all other decisions remain in force.

physical_revision.answer_batch_policy: Retain the original 27 reaffirmed implementation answers and their historical answers. Add the captured resolved human_answer for the calibrated geometry/tool revision, with its exact work-item identity, summary and evidence Artifact IDs; this is the same delegated authorization already materialized in revision 2.

feedback_binding.scope: Publish the canonical-validated calibrated draft for existing freezers; retain original failed physical evidence.

physical_execution.reason: Use already available source-pinned/public-replay OpenROAD matching the original baseline/frequency arm. Old26Q3/16core evidence remains a separate unqualified attempt.
physical_execution.invocation_policy: For the revised physical phase invoke /tmp/chipnebula-pinned-tools/bin/openroad explicitly with 2 threads and NUM_CORES=2; record requested path, real resolved binary, SHA256, version, actual thread count, command and input/output hashes for each affected stage. Do not rely on an ambient openroad from PATH.
physical_execution.qualification: Verify selected binary/version/hash after loading the environment; later formal common acceptance retains its separate pinned Verilator/runtime obligations.

required_before_pnr_can_qualify: Existing physical-constraints author publishes a new canonical-validated draft; existing freezer confirms a new immutable version
Existing acceptance-plan author updates only calibrated geometry/tool identity binding then existing freezer confirms new plan version
Native PNR reruns/revalidates affected physical stages with actual selected4a7cf binary/2threads and new formal inputs; do not simply relabel old26Q3 layout
Close external reset waveform and all required downstream acceptance; unavailable power models stay explicitly unavailable
Bind all final export hashes to the same final physical revision; old failure cannot become retrospectivePASS
freeze_dependencies: New constraints draft reviewed/edited/explicitly confirmed and frozen only by the existing platform freezer
New AC-FLOORPLAN/tool-binding acceptance revision confirmed and frozen by the existing acceptance owner/freezer
physical_qualification.affected_physical_stages: Rerun or revalidate affected floorplan, rows/pins, placement, CTS/repair, routing/extraction, setup/hold/electrical, router/independent DRC, LVS, antenna and final export consistency against the new formal inputs. Record stage evidence and exact final hashes; old artifacts are not qualified by relabeling.
physical_qualification.reset: Revalidate the required external low pulse >=200 ns, release 49..51 ns including bounded skew and joint memory reset against the new formal inputs; retain recovery/removal/library pulse checks.
physical_qualification.functional_evidence_reuse: Only with exact source, signed specification, qualified RTL and immutable checker/corpus binding; preserve all original architectural/functional/scoring thresholds.

historical_physical_evidence.v1_strict_core_failure: Preserved as failed; planning and measured row bboxes differ. This revision is prospective and supplies no exception or retrospective PASS under V1.
historical_physical_evidence.historical_execution_qualification: Separate unqualified attempt for the new physical revision; the independent 4a7cf reader audit does not establish the historical build used that selected binary.

original_receipt.caveat: Resolve actual tool site-snapping semantics against frozen constraints. Do not silently equate requested and observed bboxes or waive requirements.
